title: Lānaʻi harbor damaged by storm
summary: As of the September 8 meeting, a Lānaʻi member reported that a storm has badly damaged the harbor where the island receives its gasoline and food supplies. The crane used to unload boats there is in pieces. There is also a long line for gas.

timeline.text: Emergency crews stabilized the collapsed pier apron and sinkhole with geotextile fabric, Kyowa bags, grout and boulders.

source.quote: The department said on the land side, crews began filling a sinkhole with a combination of geotextile fabrics, Kyowa bags, grout and boulders.

timeline.text: The crane used to unload boats at the harbor is in pieces, and there is a long line for gas.
A Lānaʻi member said a storm badly damaged the harbor that receives gasoline and food.
